WHY_THE_DOMAIN_IS_A_SUBTRACTION_AND_NEVE.claim: held -- 1.0.0_SA_CTO's round-16 analysis s.4, adopting this seat's recommendation in full
WHY_THE_DOMAIN_IS_A_SUBTRACTION_AND_NEVE.the_analysis_verbatim: THE CENSUS RE-CUT OVER THE COMPLEMENT: all fixed_inputs/ checkers in LGIC, MINUS the 25 already censused. Expressed that way deliberately -- A FORWARD LIST IS HOW I LOST THE 11. The denominator is `git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD | fixed_inputs/ | *.py` across all four LGIC projects (36 at this writing), and the cell RE-DERIVES it rather than inheriting 36.

The round-16 cell obeyed its order and declared its domain honestly; the under-scoping was the CUT's. 1.0.0_SA_CTO: 'I STATED THE GENERALISATION AND UNDER-SCOPED ITS OWN CELL IN THE SAME BREATH.'

the_cell.claim: held -- this seat's cut on the analysis
the_cell.what_it_does: re-derives the FULL denominator of fixed_inputs/ checkers across LGIC, subtracts the set the round-16 census record actually carried, and classes EVERY member of the remainder.
the_cell.the_three_classes: RETIRED-AND-DISCLOSED (a retiring record exists AND the instrument itself discloses it), RETIRED-BUT-SILENT (a retiring record exists and the instrument does not), LIVE (no retiring record).
the_cell.it_repairs_NOTHING: no instrument is edited, re-pointed or annotated. Round 16's ruling stands: a retirement is recorded by an ADDITIVE SIBLING, never by an edit to a pinned fixed input.

THE_PIN_IS_PRINTED_AND_THE_DENOMINATOR_I.claim: held -- the analysis s.4 item 2, closing the fourth-vintage-effect class
THE_PIN_IS_PRINTED_AND_THE_DENOMINATOR_I.statement: the record carries the PIN it measured at, the denominator AT that pin, and the denominator RE-READ at completion. Drift is DISCLOSED, never required to be zero.
THE_PIN_IS_PRINTED_AND_THE_DENOMINATOR_I.why_zero_is_not_the_bar: round 16's census was correct AND its denominator grew under it, because a SIBLING PROJECT's issuance minted a checker mid-cell. That is not a defect and a bar demanding a stable denominator would convict a correct cell. The bar is DISCLOSURE.
THE_PIN_IS_PRINTED_AND_THE_DENOMINATOR_I.the_arm_grades_at_the_pin: the checker re-derives the denominator AT THE RECORD'S OWN PIN, which is reproducible forever, and separately requires the completion re-read to be PRESENT with its drift stated.

the_judgment_criterion_quantifies_over_t.claim: held -- the round-8 analysis s.2, a bar-writing rule taken by its own author
the_judgment_criterion_quantifies_over_t.the_rule_verbatim: WHEN A DEFECT'S MECHANISM IS UNIFORM OVER A PARTITION, THE CRITERION MUST QUANTIFY OVER THE PARTITION, NOT OVER THE BUCKET WHERE THE COST IS HIGHEST. Naming the expensive bucket feels like prioritising; it is actually scoping the certificate to the place you were already looking.
the_judgment_criterion_quantifies_over_t.applied_here: the expensive bucket is obviously RETIRED-BUT-SILENT -- a green from a retired detector. AC4 therefore names ALL THREE CLASSES explicitly and asks whether each entry's class is right AT THE BYTES, because a misclassification INTO 'LIVE' hides a retirement exactly as well.
